column1: # Iliad - Part 1.5 — naskah 01 (M23001): Dandelion keluar dari Special Control Zone.
# Tetap Inggris: White Zone, URNC, Stasi, Frame, Doll, Dandelion, Augustus, Romy,
# Miss Q, Commander (dipakai "Komandan" karena sebutan, bukan nama).
(White Zone, URNC Government Building.)
column2: (White Zone, Gedung Pemerintahan URNC.)

column1: (36th Floor, Special Control Zone.)
column2: (Lantai 36, Special Control Zone.)

column1: (From the outside, this place looks no different from other government buildings—the same corridors, the same lighting, the same AC vents.)
column2: (Dari luar, tempat ini tampak sama saja dengan gedung pemerintahan lain—koridor yang sama, pencahayaan yang sama, ventilasi AC yang sama.)

column1: (But if one observes closely, one will discover some subtle differences.)
column2: (Tapi kalau diamati baik-baik, ada beberapa perbedaan halus yang akan terlihat.)

column1: (In the clean and tidy corridor, there is not even a single electronic screen. The lighting uses old-fashioned fluorescent tubes, controlled by independent mechanical switches, with wiring embedded in lead-filled pipes. The AC system is also purely a physical circulation loop, with no temperature control chips involved.)
column2: (Di koridor yang bersih dan rapi ini, tidak ada satu pun layar elektronik. Penerangannya memakai lampu neon model lama, dikendalikan sakelar mekanis terpisah, dengan kabel tertanam di pipa berisi timbal. Sistem AC-nya pun murni sirkulasi fisik, tanpa cip pengatur suhu sama sekali.)

column1: (Even the walls themselves have been specially treated—lined with six layers of electromagnetic shielding materials of different densities, completely isolating this area from all electronic signals from the outside world.)
column2: (Bahkan dindingnya pun digarap khusus—dilapisi enam lapis material perisai elektromagnetik dengan kerapatan berbeda, mengisolasi area ini sepenuhnya dari segala sinyal elektronik dunia luar.)

column1: (All the room door locks in sight are pure mechanical Swiss lock cylinders. The keys are carried by the duty personnel and rotated every twelve hours.)
column2: (Semua kunci pintu ruangan di sini murni silinder mekanis buatan Swiss. Kuncinya dibawa petugas jaga dan dirotasi tiap dua belas jam.)

column1: (Surveillance also does not rely on any cameras—every entrance and exit from the 35th to the 37th floor is continuously monitored visually 24 hours a day by screened Stasi agents.)
column2: (Pengawasannya pun tidak mengandalkan kamera—tiap pintu masuk dan keluar dari lantai 35 sampai 37 diawasi langsung dengan mata 24 jam nonstop oleh agen Stasi yang sudah disaring.)

column1: (Their weapons are also specially customized: the gun body is made of nylon, carbon fiber, and ceramic composite materials, and the magazine is loaded with hardened polymer bullets with chemical primers. This specially made firearm ensures that there is not a single electronic component from inside out that can be jammed by an electromagnetic pulse or remotely controlled.)
column2: (Senjata mereka juga dibuat khusus: bodinya dari nilon, serat karbon, dan komposit keramik, magasinnya diisi peluru polimer keras berprimer kimia. Senjata rakitan khusus ini memastikan tak ada satu pun komponen elektronik, dari luar sampai dalam, yang bisa dilumpuhkan pulsa elektromagnetik atau dikendalikan dari jauh.)

column1: (The agents' communication was even more primitive: the communication between the agents on guard used point-to-point speaking tubes. There wasn't even a single circuit board in the mouthpiece—sound was transmitted directly through resin tubes, without any digital or analog signal conversion.)
column2: (Komunikasi para agen bahkan lebih primitif: agen yang berjaga bicara lewat pipa suara titik-ke-titik. Di corongnya tidak ada satu pun papan sirkuit—suara dialirkan langsung melalui tabung resin, tanpa konversi sinyal digital maupun analog.)

column1: (And when they needed to report outside, a dedicated person would walk downstairs to the communication room on the second floor to use an isolated terminal.)
column2: (Dan kalau perlu melapor ke luar, ada petugas khusus yang turun ke ruang komunikasi di lantai dua untuk memakai terminal terisolasi.)

column1: (All design concepts for this area can be boiled down to the same principle—)
column2: (Semua konsep desain area ini bermuara pada satu prinsip yang sama—)

column1: ("Eliminate electronic signals".)
column2: ("Hapuskan sinyal elektronik".)

column1: (And all of this is just to guard one person.)
column2: (Dan semua ini cuma untuk menjaga satu orang.)

column1: (A black-haired girl who is currently sitting in the office, boredly twirling her hair with her fingers.)
column2: (Seorang gadis berambut hitam yang saat ini duduk di kantor, memilin-milin rambutnya dengan jari karena bosan.)

column1: ...You really do make some unreasonable demands, dear sister.
column2: ...Permintaanmu benar-benar tidak masuk akal, Kakak sayang.

column1: (She muttered to herself, as if she didn't have anyone in particular to chat with.)
column2: (Dia bergumam sendiri, seolah tidak sedang bicara dengan siapa pun.)

column1: (Before her eyes, the furnishings of the office she was in could be described as comfortable—or more bluntly, downright luxurious.)
column2: (Di hadapannya, perabot kantor yang ia tempati bisa disebut nyaman—atau blak-blakan saja: mewah.)

column1: (Solid wood bookshelves, hand-bound paper books, a carved oak desk, and even a bouquet of fresh flowers replaced by a dedicated person every three days.)
column2: (Rak buku kayu solid, buku kertas jilid tangan, meja ek berukir, bahkan seikat bunga segar yang diganti petugas khusus setiap tiga hari.)

column1: (If she ever gets bored of these, she only needs to make a request, and within half an hour, she can be transported to an unsimulated, real outdoor beach to enjoy a pure, healthy sunbath.)
column2: (Kalau dia bosan dengan semua itu, cukup mengajukan permintaan, dan dalam setengah jam dia bisa diantar ke pantai asli—bukan simulasi—untuk berjemur sepuasnya.)

column1: (All of this is courtesy of the Stasi guarding her—or rather, a sign of sincerity from the 'URNC'.)
column2: (Semua ini berkat Stasi yang menjaganya—atau lebih tepatnya, tanda ketulusan dari 'URNC'.)

column1: ...Mm, of course.
column2: ...Mm, tentu saja.

column1: I know—this is a 'necessary action'.
column2: Aku tahu—ini 'tindakan yang perlu'.

column1: (She loosens her curled hair and watches it spring back to its original arc.)
column2: (Dia melepas rambutnya yang terpilin dan menonton helai itu memantul kembali ke lengkungan semula.)

column1: (Then she stood up.)
column2: (Lalu dia berdiri.)

column1: Alright—although it's a bit of a pity to give up my free sunbath.
column2: Baiklah—walau sayang juga melepas jatah berjemur gratisku.

column1: Still, I can just make the Commander properly make it up to me, right?
column2: Lagi pula, aku tinggal minta Komandan menggantinya dengan pantas, kan?

column1: (There was no dramatic trigger.)
column2: (Tidak ada pemicu dramatis apa pun.)

column1: (She just stood up, patted the non-existent wrinkles on her skirt, and got up to walk towards the door.)
column2: (Dia hanya berdiri, menepuk kerutan yang sebenarnya tidak ada di roknya, lalu melangkah ke arah pintu.)

column1: (In the corridor, the two agents closest to the office door noticed the movement inside almost simultaneously.)
column2: (Di koridor, dua agen terdekat dari pintu kantor menyadari gerakan di dalam nyaris bersamaan.)

column1: (They'd been carrying out this duty for so long that they'd nearly forgotten just how dangerous the person inside that room was.)
column2: (Mereka sudah menjalankan tugas ini begitu lama sampai hampir lupa betapa berbahayanya orang di dalam ruangan itu.)

column1: (But the reason they'd been chosen and assigned here was that they were well-trained, and never let their guard down, no matter the circumstances.)
column2: (Tapi alasan mereka dipilih dan ditempatkan di sini justru karena mereka terlatih, dan tidak pernah lengah dalam kondisi apa pun.)

column1: (When the door pushed open from the inside made its first sound, the muzzles of the ceramic guns were already aimed at the doorframe.)
column2: (Begitu pintu yang didorong dari dalam mengeluarkan bunyi pertamanya, moncong senapan keramik sudah membidik kusen pintu.)

column1: —Halt, please return to your room.
column2: —Berhenti, silakan kembali ke ruangan Anda.

column1: (Dandelion poked half her face out from the crack in the door, like a girl next door peeking to see if there were any unfamiliar strangers in the corridor.)
column2: (Dandelion menyembulkan separuh wajahnya dari celah pintu, seperti gadis tetangga yang mengintip apakah ada orang asing di koridor.)

column1: Thank you for your hard work, is today's shift going smoothly~?
column2: Terima kasih atas kerja kerasnya, shift hari ini lancar~?

column1: Please return to your room.
column2: Silakan kembali ke ruangan Anda.

column1: Until instructions from superiors are received, you are not allowed to leave the control zone.
column2: Sampai ada perintah dari atasan, Anda tidak diizinkan meninggalkan control zone.

column1: Mhm, I know~
column2: Mhm, aku tahu~

column1: But today is a little special.
column2: Tapi hari ini agak spesial.

column1: (She pushed the door completely open.)
column2: (Dia mendorong pintu sampai terbuka lebar.)

column1: I've got, um... a bit of girl stuff to take care of.
column2: Aku ada, umm... sedikit urusan cewek yang harus diurus.

column1: (The agent captain's pupils contracted slightly.)
column2: (Pupil sang kapten agen menyempit sedikit.)

column1: (In his seventeen-year career, he had faced cruel rebels, hysterical terrorists, and out-of-control military Dolls.)
column2: (Dalam karier tujuh belas tahunnya, dia pernah menghadapi pemberontak kejam, teroris histeris, dan Doll militer yang lepas kendali.)

column1: (—yet none of it had ever pressed down on him the way this did now, standing in front of this girl who was simply smiling.)
column2: (—tapi tidak satu pun pernah menekannya seberat sekarang, berdiri di depan gadis yang cuma tersenyum ini.)

column1: ...All personnel on alert.
column2: ...Seluruh personel siaga.

column1: (As soon as he finished speaking, twelve fully armed special agents filed out from behind the isolation doors at both ends of the corridor.)
column2: (Begitu ucapannya selesai, dua belas agen khusus bersenjata lengkap keluar berbaris dari balik pintu isolasi di kedua ujung koridor.)

column1: (Ceramic guns, carbon-fiber restraints, polymer net launchers designed specifically to restrict a Doll's physical capabilities—the commonality among all this equipment is that not a single one requires electricity.)
column2: (Senapan keramik, borgol serat karbon, peluncur jaring polimer yang dirancang khusus untuk mengekang kemampuan fisik Doll—kesamaan semua perlengkapan ini: tidak satu pun butuh listrik.)

column1: Ah~ what a grand display.
column2: Ah~ meriah sekali sambutannya.

column1: (She took her shoulder off the doorframe and slowly walked into the corridor.)
column2: (Dia melepas sandaran bahunya dari kusen pintu dan berjalan pelan ke koridor.)

column1: Actually, I've been wanting to ask for a while now—
column2: Sebenarnya, sudah lama aku ingin bertanya—

column1: Have you ever considered this?
column2: Pernahkah kalian memikirkan ini?

column1: Final warning—
column2: Peringatan terakhir—

column1: The design of this building is indeed very outstanding.
column2: Desain gedung ini memang luar biasa.

column1: No electronic devices, no network signal, no terminals that I can hack into.
column2: Tidak ada perangkat elektronik, tidak ada sinyal jaringan, tidak ada terminal yang bisa kuretas.

column1: I'm quite happy to feel your attention and respect for me, but...
column2: Aku cukup senang merasakan perhatian dan rasa hormat kalian padaku, tapi...

column1: You seem to have forgotten one thing~
column2: Sepertinya kalian melupakan satu hal~

column1: (Her tone carried a hint of playfulness.)
column2: (Nadanya menyiratkan sedikit keisengan.)

column1: ...Could it be that you've never once considered…
column2: ...Jangan-jangan kalian belum pernah sekali pun berpikir…

column1: ...what you'd do if I decided to leave using 'other means'?
column2: ...apa yang akan kalian lakukan kalau aku memutuskan pergi dengan 'cara lain'?

column1: FIRE!
column2: TEMBAK!

column1: ("Bang bang bang—")
column2: ("Dor dor dor—")

column1: (The sound of polymer bullets firing was short and muffled, not as piercing as gunpowder weapons.)
column2: (Bunyi tembakan peluru polimer pendek dan teredam, tidak setajam senjata mesiu.)

column1: (Over a dozen bullets were fired at Dandelion from extremely close range—but not a single one actually hit.)
column2: (Lebih dari selusin peluru dilepaskan ke arah Dandelion dari jarak sangat dekat—tapi tidak satu pun mengenainya.)

column1: Although it wouldn't matter if I let you hit me.
column2: Padahal tidak masalah juga kalau kubiarkan kalian mengenaiku.

column1: But this Frame will be of great use later.
column2: Tapi Frame ini akan sangat berguna nanti.

column1: Even if it's just a little bit, I can't let you damage it.
column2: Sekecil apa pun, aku tidak boleh membiarkannya rusak.

column1: (Her body moved smoothly through the barrage, without any superfluous movements.)
column2: (Tubuhnya bergerak mulus menembus hujan peluru, tanpa gerakan berlebih sedikit pun.)

column1: (The trajectory of the bullets, to her, is like streaks of rain suspended in the air.)
column2: (Lintasan peluru, bagi dia, seperti garis-garis hujan yang menggantung di udara.)

column1: (Rustle...)
column2: (Srek...)

column1: (And at that very moment, a faint, indistinguishable sound echoed in the corridor.)
column2: (Dan tepat saat itu, sebuah bunyi samar yang sulit dikenali bergema di koridor.)

column1: (It was some kind of metal—no, something finer than metal.)
column2: (Semacam logam—bukan, sesuatu yang lebih halus dari logam.)

column1: (Some substance between liquid and solid was spreading outward from Dandelion's fingertips.)
column2: (Suatu zat di antara cair dan padat menyebar keluar dari ujung jari Dandelion.)

column1: (It was the nanomachines her Frame hadn't reactivated in ten years.)
column2: (Itu nanomesin yang sudah sepuluh tahun tidak diaktifkan Frame-nya.)

column1: (Like a cat bearing its claws from its paw pads.)
column2: (Seperti kucing yang mengeluarkan cakar dari bantalan kakinya.)

column1: Wh... what...!
(The spreading silver-gray fluid takes shape in an instant, covering the forearm of Dandelion's right hand and forming a thin, sharp gauntlet.)
column2: (Cairan kelabu perak yang menyebar itu langsung membentuk wujud, menyelimuti lengan bawah kanan Dandelion menjadi sarung tangan besi yang tipis dan tajam.)

column1: (She gently waved her hand.)
column2: (Dia mengayunkan tangannya pelan.)

column1: ("Crack—")
column2: ("Krak—")

column1: (The isolation door on the left side of the corridor—the one made of reinforced composite material, built to withstand tremendous force—was severed clean at the base, frame and all, in an instant.)
column2: (Pintu isolasi di sisi kiri koridor—yang terbuat dari komposit diperkuat dan dirancang menahan gaya luar biasa—terpotong rapi sampai ke pangkal, berikut kusennya, dalam sekejap.)

column1: (The cross-section was as smooth as a mirror.)
column2: (Penampang potongannya semulus cermin.)

column1: Ah... guess I'm still not used to using this much strength.
column2: Ah... sepertinya aku masih belum terbiasa memakai tenaga sebesar ini.

column1: Feels so strange.
column2: Rasanya aneh sekali.

column1: (A certain frozen silence permeated the corridor.)
column2: (Keheningan yang membeku menyelimuti koridor.)

column1: (The dozen or so highly trained elite agents who had survived countless actual battles were all frozen in place at this moment.)
column2: (Belasan agen elite terlatih yang selamat dari pertempuran nyata tak terhitung itu semuanya mematung saat ini.)

column1: ...Everyone fall back, activate—
column2: ...Semuanya mundur, aktifkan—

column1: Too late for that~
column2: Sudah telat~

column1: (She stepped forward, and with every step, the walls beside her peeled away to the sides like paper.)
column2: (Dia melangkah maju, dan tiap langkahnya membuat dinding di sisinya terkelupas ke samping seperti kertas.)

column1: (This wasn't even intentional on her part, some kind of force simply radiated outward from around her body on its own.)
column2: (Itu pun bukan disengaja olehnya; semacam daya begitu saja memancar sendiri dari sekeliling tubuhnya.)

column1: (Nanofluid roamed around her body, sometimes condensing into a shield surface to deflect sporadic incoming bullets, sometimes extending into blades to cut open obstacles blocking the front.)
column2: (Nanofluida berkeliaran di sekitar tubuhnya, kadang memadat jadi bidang perisai untuk menepis peluru yang datang sporadis, kadang memanjang jadi bilah untuk membelah penghalang di depan.)

column1: (Dandelion didn't even deliberately quicken her pace.)
column2: (Dandelion bahkan tidak sengaja mempercepat langkahnya.)

column1: Ah, right—
column2: Ah, iya—

column1: Sorry, could you do me a favor and let the minister know?
column2: Maaf, boleh minta tolong sampaikan ke Menteri?

column1: (She turned her head and showed an 'apologetic' smile to those agents who had completely lost their will to fight.)
column2: (Dia menoleh dan melempar senyum 'minta maaf' kepada para agen yang sudah kehilangan seluruh kehendak bertarungnya.)

column1: Those books in the office, take good care of them for me.
column2: Buku-buku di kantor itu, tolong dijaga baik-baik untukku.

column1: There are a few I haven't finished reading yet~
column2: Masih ada beberapa yang belum selesai kubaca~

column1: (No one gives an answer, but Dandelion doesn't mind.)
column2: (Tidak ada yang menjawab, tapi Dandelion tidak keberatan.)

column1: (She turned back and walked through the last blast wall she had casually pushed aside, as if taking a stroll.)
column2: (Dia berbalik dan melewati dinding ledak terakhir yang tadi disingkirkannya santai, seolah sedang jalan-jalan.)

column1: (The clean and pure wind, exclusive to the White Zone, rushes in.)
column2: (Angin bersih dan murni, khas White Zone, menyeruak masuk.)

column1: The weather is really nice.
column2: Cuacanya bagus sekali.

column1: (She takes a leap, and a pair of butterfly-like wings unfolds behind her.)
column2: (Dia melompat, dan sepasang sayap serupa kupu-kupu terbentang di punggungnya.)

column1: (While in the corridor behind her, all that is left is a complete mess.)
column2: (Sementara di koridor di belakangnya, yang tersisa hanyalah kekacauan total.)

column1: (Somewhere on a street in the White Zone.)
column2: (Di suatu jalan di White Zone.)

column1: (The Frame's wings could only allow her to glide. After arriving at the destination, Dandelion folded them away.)
column2: (Sayap Frame itu hanya memungkinkannya meluncur. Setelah sampai tujuan, Dandelion melipatnya kembali.)

column1: (The strong wind blew her hair a bit messy. Now, she once again restored that ordinary girl-like appearance.)
column2: (Angin kencang membuat rambutnya sedikit berantakan. Kini dia kembali tampak seperti gadis biasa.)

column1: (Beep.)
column2: (Bip.)

column1: (Communication connected.)
column2: (Komunikasi tersambung.)

column1: (The moment she left the shielded area, an encrypted communication request immediately found her with pinpoint precision.)
column2: (Begitu dia keluar dari area berperisai, sebuah permintaan komunikasi terenkripsi langsung menemukannya dengan presisi.)

column1: (Dandelion glanced at the source ID and smiled softly.)
column2: (Dandelion melirik ID pengirimnya dan tersenyum tipis.)

column1: Wow~ so fast, as expected of Miss Q.
column2: Wah~ cepat sekali, memang beda Miss Q.

column1: Ah, I should call you Minister Augustus now~
column2: Ah, sekarang aku harus memanggilmu Menteri Augustus, ya~

column1: My young lady, who upset you this time?
column2: Nona muda, siapa yang membuatmu kesal kali ini?

column1: Moreover, thirty-seven seconds, you only took thirty-seven seconds to break through the formation I spent a large budget to create.
column2: Lagi pula, tiga puluh tujuh detik—kau cuma butuh tiga puluh tujuh detik untuk menembus formasi yang kubangun dengan anggaran besar.

column1: You're making my report very hard to write.
column2: Kau membuat laporanku jadi sangat sulit ditulis.

column1: Sorry about that~ I'm in a hurry.
column2: Maaf soal itu~ Aku sedang buru-buru.

column1: In a hurry? What? Someone asked you out for coffee?
column2: Buru-buru? Apa? Ada yang mengajakmu ngopi?

column1: Mind if I tag along? I promise to sit next to you and not say a word, just let me record your conversation.
column2: Keberatan kalau aku ikut? Aku janji cuma duduk di sebelahmu tanpa bicara, asal boleh merekam percakapan kalian.

column1: I'm really sorry, my date doesn't really like third wheels.
column2: Maaf sekali, kencanku kurang suka ada obat nyamuk.

column1: That's a pity.
column2: Sayang sekali.

column1: (The teasing voice suddenly disappeared, and on the other end of the communication, Augustus was silent for two seconds.)
column2: (Nada menggoda itu tiba-tiba lenyap, dan di ujung sana Augustus terdiam dua detik.)

column1: (And when the voice sounded again, that layer of playful disguise was deliberately removed a bit.)
column2: (Dan saat suaranya terdengar lagi, lapisan samaran jenaka itu sengaja dikurangi sedikit.)

column1: The building damage report for the control zone has already been delivered to my desk.
column2: Laporan kerusakan gedung untuk control zone sudah sampai di mejaku.

column1: Structural damage spanning three security zones, two blast walls destroyed beyond repair, one isolation door severed clean at the root—
column2: Kerusakan struktural mencakup tiga zona keamanan, dua dinding ledak hancur tak bisa diperbaiki, satu pintu isolasi terpotong rapi sampai pangkal—

column1: Although I knew early on that you could leave whenever you wanted, they never told me you were such a monster.
column2: Meski sejak awal aku tahu kau bisa pergi kapan saja, tidak ada yang bilang kau semonster ini.

column1: How can you say that about me, I'm just naturally strong.
column2: Kok tega bilang begitu, aku cuma kuat dari sananya.

column1: Fortunately there were no casualties, I'll be sure to report that accurately.
column2: Untungnya tidak ada korban jiwa, itu pasti kulaporkan dengan akurat.

column1: After all, those handsome guys have been pretty good to me all this time.
column2: Lagi pula, para pria tampan itu selama ini baik-baik saja padaku.

column1: I didn't want to get into any conflicts with you guys either.
column2: Aku juga tidak mau berkonflik dengan kalian.

column1: That's truly good news.
column2: Itu kabar yang benar-benar bagus.

column1: Then I'm curious—if you didn't want to fall out with us, what was the point of suddenly pulling this stunt?
column2: Kalau begitu aku penasaran—kalau kau tidak mau pecah kongsi dengan kami, apa gunanya tiba-tiba bikin ulah begini?

column1: (Dandelion didn't answer, and there was another brief silence in the communication.)
column2: (Dandelion tidak menjawab, dan komunikasi kembali hening sejenak.)

column1: We've been dealing with each other for several years now.
column2: Kita sudah berurusan satu sama lain selama beberapa tahun.

column1: Over the years, I've never asked much about your affairs, because I know some things are not for me to know.
column2: Selama ini aku tidak pernah banyak bertanya soal urusanmu, karena aku tahu ada hal-hal yang bukan hakku untuk tahu.

column1: You've also always been very cooperative with us and never caused me trouble. For this, I am very grateful.
column2: Kau juga selalu sangat kooperatif dan tidak pernah merepotkanku. Untuk itu aku sangat berterima kasih.

column1: So I don't want to play those roundabout games with you, I'll just ask directly.
column2: Jadi aku tidak mau bermain kata denganmu, aku tanya langsung saja.

column1: Why today?
column2: Kenapa hari ini?

column1: Give me a reason, at least make it look better when I write the report.
column2: Beri aku alasan, setidaknya biar laporanku terlihat lebih pantas.

column1: Hmm—how should I put it...
column2: Hmm—bagaimana ya menjelaskannya...

column1: (Dandelion raised her head and looked at the clear sky above.)
column2: (Dandelion mendongak menatap langit cerah di atasnya.)

column1: Because my vacation is over, and my personal driver is already on her way to pick me up.
column2: Karena liburanku sudah selesai, dan sopir pribadiku sudah dalam perjalanan menjemputku.

column1: ...Personal driver?
column2: ...Sopir pribadi?

column1: She has a very bad temper~ If I'm too late, she might just... 'boom' and self-destruct to show me.
column2: Temperamennya jelek sekali~ Kalau aku terlalu lama, bisa-bisa dia... 'duar' meledakkan diri di depanku.

column1: Madam Minister~
column2: Bu Menteri~

column1: ...Say what?
column2: ...Bilang apa?

column1: Thank you for your care over the years.
column2: Terima kasih atas perhatianmu selama bertahun-tahun ini.

column1: If you get demoted or something because of this, please don't blame me.
column2: Kalau kau sampai turun jabatan gara-gara ini, tolong jangan salahkan aku.

column1: If you're lucky enough to avoid getting in trouble over this, I'll leave the books to you, then—
column2: Kalau kau cukup beruntung tidak kena masalah karena ini, buku-buku itu kutitipkan padamu, ya—

column1: ("Buzz—")
column2: ("Bzzt—")

column1: (The communication signal instantly disconnected.)
column2: (Sinyal komunikasi langsung terputus.)

column1: (In an instant, Dandelion snuffed out the tracking signal Augustus used to lock onto her from the source.)
column2: (Dalam sekejap, Dandelion memadamkan sinyal pelacak yang dipakai Augustus untuk mengunci posisinya, langsung dari sumbernya.)

column1: (The channel was swallowed by some invisible force in an instant, leaving not even a trace of residual data.)
column2: (Kanal itu ditelan suatu daya tak kasatmata dalam sekejap, tanpa menyisakan jejak data sedikit pun.)

column1: Sigh, I really quite liked her.
column2: Hah, padahal aku cukup menyukainya.

column1: (Shaking her head, Dandelion shrugged and turned to walk away into the distance.)
column2: (Sambil menggeleng, Dandelion mengangkat bahu lalu berbalik dan berjalan menjauh.)

column1: (Augustus stared at the tracking interface in front of her, which had suddenly gone dark, her expression utterly unreadable.)
column2: (Augustus menatap antarmuka pelacak di depannya yang mendadak gelap, dengan ekspresi yang sama sekali tak terbaca.)

column1: (—Really, what was there to be surprised about? She was just going by the book, but no one could blame her for failing to take down a giant black bear armed with nothing but a bamboo spear, right?)
column2: (—Sungguh, apa yang perlu dikagetkan? Dia cuma menjalankan prosedur, dan tidak ada yang bisa menyalahkannya karena gagal menumbangkan beruang hitam raksasa hanya berbekal tombak bambu, kan?)

column1: (She picked up the terminal on her desk, fingers flying across the virtual keyboard—incident report, damage assessment request, aftermath disposal plan, restricted zone downgrade and reassessment procedures—)
column2: (Dia mengambil terminal di mejanya, jarinya melesat di papan ketik virtual—laporan insiden, permohonan penilaian kerusakan, rencana penanganan pascakejadian, prosedur penurunan status dan penilaian ulang zona terbatas—)

column1: (This is the work she is best at. Since she was just an agent, she has been best at filling out reimbursement forms.)
column2: (Inilah pekerjaan yang paling dia kuasai. Sejak masih agen biasa, dia memang paling jago mengisi formulir penggantian biaya.)

column1: (Only after everything was completed did she very reluctantly open another communication channel.)
column2: (Baru setelah semuanya rampung, dengan sangat enggan dia membuka satu kanal komunikasi lagi.)

column1: ...Ah~ Good afternoon, dear General Romy. I have some good news and some bad news to tell you... Ahaha~
column2: ...Ah~ Selamat siang, Jenderal Romy yang terhormat. Aku punya kabar baik dan kabar buruk untukmu... Ahaha~
